sentences.text: Everton F.C. -LSB- ˈɛvərtən -RSB- is a football club in Liverpool , England , that currently competes in the Premier League , the top flight of English football .	football	association football	Liverpool	Liverpool F.C.	England	England	Premier League	Premier League	English football	Football in England

The club have competed in the top division for a record 114 seasons and won the League Championship nine times , and the FA Cup five times .	record 114 seasons	Football records in England#Top-flight appearances	League Championship	List of English football champions	FA Cup	FA Cup

Formed in 1878 , Everton were founding members of The Football League in 1888 and won their first League Championship two seasons later .	League Championship	List of English football champions	The Football League	The Football League	two seasons later	1890–91 Everton F.C. season

Following four League Championship and two FA Cup wins , Everton experienced a lull in the immediate post World War Two period , until a revival in the 1960s , which saw the club win two League Championships and an FA Cup .	League Championship	List of English football champions	FA Cup	FA Cup
The mid-1980s represented their most recent period of sustained success , with two League Championships , an FA Cup , and the 1985 European Cup Winners ' Cup .	FA Cup	FA Cup
The club 's most recent major trophy was the 1995 FA Cup .	FA Cup	FA Cup	1995 FA Cup	1995 FA Cup Final
The club 's supporters are known as Evertonians .	Evertonians	Everton F.C. supporters
Everton have a rivalry with neighbours Liverpool , and the two sides contest the Merseyside derby .	Liverpool	Liverpool F.C.	Merseyside derby	Merseyside derby

The club have been based at Goodison Park in Walton , Liverpool , since 1892 , after moving from Anfield following a row over its rent .	Goodison Park	Goodison Park	Liverpool	Liverpool F.C.	Anfield	Anfield
The club 's home colours are royal blue shirts with white shorts and socks .
